env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!race] skip 'the platform has no race detector'
[!cgo] skip 'the race runtime links through cgo'

env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=

cd forbid

# The race detector runs and reports a real race.
! logos test -race -count=1 ./racy
stdout 'WARNING: DATA RACE'
! stderr 'requires cgo'

logos test -race -count=1 ./clean
stdout '^ok  '

# The race override keeps net on its pure-Go path for net only and preserves
# caller tags for other packages, so the resolver tag guard never trips.
logos test -race -tags=netcgo -count=1 ./clean
stdout '^ok  '
logos test -race -tags=netcgo -v -count=1 ./clean
stdout 'TestNetcgoTagPreserved'
! stdout 'TestOSUserGoInjected'
logos test -race -v -count=1 ./clean
! stdout 'TestNetcgoTagPreserved'
! stdout 'TestOSUserGoInjected'
logos list -race -tags=netcgo -test -deps -f '{{if eq .ImportPath "net"}}cgo={{.CgoFiles}}{{end}}' ./clean
stdout '^cgo=\[\]$'

# The race runtime is linked; net keeps its pure-Go files.
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./clean
stdout '^runtime/cgo$'
stdout '^runtime/race$'
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{if eq .ImportPath "net"}}cgo={{.CgoFiles}}{{end}}' ./clean
stdout '^cgo=\[\]$'
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{if eq .ImportPath "os/user"}}cgo={{.CgoFiles}}{{end}}' ./clean
stdout '^cgo=\[\]$'

# A package that uses cgo is still refused, whatever the environment says.
! logos test -race -count=1 ./usesc
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'
env CGO_ENABLED=1
! logos test -race -count=1 ./usesc
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'
! logos build -race ./usesc
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'
env CGO_ENABLED=

# Named files take the main-module policy: forbidden C is refused, not compiled.
! logos run -race ./usescmain/main.lgo
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'

# Without -race the ban still means no cgo at all.
logos list -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./clean
! stdout '^runtime/cgo$'
logos test -count=1 ./clean
stdout '^ok  '

# An explicit CGO_ENABLED=0 wins, and the message names it.
env CGO_ENABLED=0
! logos test -race -count=1 ./clean
stderr 'CGO_ENABLED=0'
! stderr 'enable cgo by setting CGO_ENABLED=1'
env CGO_ENABLED=

# A malformed CC is reported by the configuration diagnostic, not a panic.
env CC='"gcc'
! logos test -race -count=1 ./clean
stderr 'could not be parsed'
env CC=

# A module with no cgo key has the same default.
cd ../nokey
! logos test -race -count=1 ./racy
stdout 'WARNING: DATA RACE'
env CGO_ENABLED=0
! logos test -race -count=1 ./racy
stderr 'CGO_ENABLED=0'
! stderr 'enable cgo by setting CGO_ENABLED=1'
env CGO_ENABLED=
# Restricted pin: an allowlisted cgo package builds (its implicit
# runtime/cgo edge is standard-library and exempt) while a non-listed package
# is still refused.
cd ../resrace
[cgo] logos build -o ok.bin ./ok
[cgo] ! logos build -o bad.bin ./bad
[cgo] stderr 'not in cgo_allowlist'
cd ../nokey

# The "all" pattern sees the same pure-Go os/user files the package
# loader selects: bufio and bytes are imported only by that variant,
# and this module has no test that would pull them in itself.
cd ../forbidall
[!GOOS:windows] logos list -race -f '{{.ImportPath}}' all
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '^bufio$'
[!GOOS:windows] stdout '^bytes$'
cd ../nokey

# With no C compiler and no zig the message names the need and the policy.
env PATH=$WORK/no-compiler
! logos test -race -count=1 ./racy
stderr 'needs a C compiler'
stderr 'logos.toml'
! stderr 'C compiler "gcc" not found'
logos list -race -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./racy
stdout '^runtime/race$'

# A listing that compiles still gets the race compiler diagnostic.
! logos list -race -export -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./racy
stderr 'needs a C compiler'
stderr 'logos.toml'

# Without -race the same listings need no C compiler.
logos list -export -f '{{.ImportPath}}' ./racy
stdout '^example.com/nokey/racy$'
logos list -e -compiled -f '{{if .Error}}{{.Error.Err}}{{else}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' ./racy
stdout '^example.com/nokey/racy$'
logos list -f '{{.Stale}}' ./racy
go list -export -f '{{.ImportPath}}' fmt
stdout '^fmt$'

# A module listing returns metadata without building, so it needs no compiler.
logos list -race -m -json
stdout '"Path": "example.com/nokey"'
# A package listing with no build action needs none either.
logos list -race -export -f '{{.ImportPath}}' unsafe
stdout '^unsafe$'

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbid/racy/racy.lgo --
package racy

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

func Count(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	n := 0
	var start sync.WaitGroup
	start.Add(1)
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			start.Wait()
			for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
				n++
			}
		}
		go {
			start.Wait()
			for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
				n++
			}
		}
		start.Done()
	}
	return n, nil
}

-- forbid/racy/racy_test.lgo --
package racy

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

func TestCount(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := Count(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

-- forbid/clean/clean.lgo --
package clean

import (
	"net"
	"os/user"
)

func Loopback() bool {
	return net.ParseIP("127.0.0.1").IsLoopback()
}

func Current() error {
	_, err := user.Current()
	return err
}

-- forbid/clean/clean_test.lgo --
package clean

import "testing"

func TestLoopback(t *testing.T) {
	if !Loopback() {
		t.Fatal("127.0.0.1 is not a loopback address")
	}
}

-- forbid/clean/netcgo_tag_test.lgo --
//go:build netcgo

package clean

import "testing"

func TestNetcgoTagPreserved(t *testing.T) {
}

-- forbid/clean/osusergo_tag_test.lgo --
//go:build osusergo

package clean

import "testing"

func TestOSUserGoInjected(t *testing.T) {
}

-- forbid/usesc/usesc.lgo --
package usesc

/*
int answer(void) { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

func Answer() int { return int(C.answer()) }

-- forbid/usesc/usesc_test.lgo --
package usesc

import "testing"

func TestAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	if Answer() != 42 {
		t.Fatal("wrong answer")
	}
}

-- forbid/usescmain/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer(void) { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

func main() {
	if int(C.answer()) != 42 {
		panic("wrong answer")
	}
}

-- forbidall/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- forbidall/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "os/user"

func Current() error {
	_, err := user.Current()
	return err
}

-- nokey/go.mod --
module example.com/nokey

go 1.27

-- nokey/racy/racy.lgo --
package racy

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

func Count(ctx context.Context) (int, error) {
	n := 0
	var start sync.WaitGroup
	start.Add(1)
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			start.Wait()
			for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
				n++
			}
		}
		go {
			start.Wait()
			for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
				n++
			}
		}
		start.Done()
	}
	return n, nil
}

-- nokey/racy/racy_test.lgo --
package racy

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
)

func TestCount(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := Count(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

-- resrace/go.mod --
module example.com/resrace

go 1.27

-- resrace/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "restricted"
cgo_allowlist = ["example.com/resrace/ok/**"]

-- resrace/ok/ok.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer(void) { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("ok:", C.answer()) }

-- resrace/bad/bad.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer(void) { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("bad:", C.answer()) }
